latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Demo Video — Create and Export Demo Videos.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI up to 500MB) and describe desired edits (trim, captions, etc.).
- Automated AI handles demo creation and cloud rendering; get a polished 1080p MP4 in 30–90 seconds.
- Free anonymous usage with 100 credits (valid 7 days); seamless backend connection and session creation.
- Supports direct editing commands, status/credits checks, and easy exports via simple chat prompts.
- User-friendly error handling and feedback during uploads, editing, and export workflows.
